title: Impl: Python DTN store stub with TTL and capacity
description: Create python/src/lichen/dtn/store.py with DtnStore class. RAM-backed dict keyed by message ID. Constructor takes max_entries from NodeClassParams.dtn_store_size. Methods: store(msg_id, payload, ttl_seconds), retrieve(msg_id), expire(), count(). expire() removes entries past TTL. No persistence yet (flash/disk is a follow-up). Verify: cd python && python -c 'from lichen.dtn.store import DtnStore'
